---
title: "Scheduled releases with Quarto"
---

This site is a compact demonstration of the
[`scheduled-docs`](https://github.com/qmd-lab/scheduled-docs) extension. The
source contains every example page from the beginning, while each full render
uses the central release calendar to decide which pages belong on the public
site.

::: {.callout-note title="Two pieces working together"}
The extension controls **what is visible when the site is rendered**. GitHub
Actions controls **when the site is rendered and deployed again**.
:::

## Demonstrated states

| Example | Date | Override | Expected public state |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| [Already released](pages/already-released.qmd) | 2020-01-01 | — | Published |
| [Scheduled release](pages/scheduled-release.qmd) | 2026-09-15 | — | Published on or after the date |
| [Manually published](pages/manually-published.qmd) | 2099-01-01 | `draft: false` | Published |
| Manually withheld | 2020-01-01 | `draft: true` | Hidden |

If a link in the table is plain text rather than clickable, Quarto classified
that destination as a draft during this render.

## Publication flow

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A["_schedule.yml"] --> B["scheduled-docs"]
    B --> C["Quarto render"]
    D["Hourly GitHub Action"] --> C
    C --> E["GitHub Pages"]
```

The repository README contains the local commands and a fixed-date simulation
procedure.
